rules.interaction: Possible conflict with the NJ statewide algorithmic rent-setting law; human review.
rules.coverage_conditions: Landlords in Jersey City; real estate agents not covered per the article
rules.title: Jersey City ban on rent-setting algorithms
rules.requirement: The city council banned landlords from using rent-setting algorithms such as RealPage, including use of certain nonpublic data in revenue management software; real estate agents were carved out at the sponsor's agreement.
rules.key_value: ban on rent-setting algorithms using nonpublic data
rules.quoted_span: The Jersey City Council unanimously approved (9-0) a measure banning rent-setting algorithms such as RealPage

notes: Article names no code section, adoption or effective date; the section 218-12 cite and June 2025 date come from the orchestrator brief, not this text, so effective_date is null. Article also mentions a $2,000 daily fine only as a speaker's comment. News piece is a secondary source.
